EMPLOYMENT CONTRACT - SYNTHETIC
Employee: Avery Example
Employer: Example Research
Start date: 2027-01-01
Monthly salary: RM6,000

PROBATION
The employee serves a six-month probation period from the start date.
During probation, either party may terminate with fourteen days written notice.

CONFIRMATION
After written confirmation, either party may terminate with sixty days written notice.
Confidentiality: The employee must protect confidential information.
